businesses.business: prescription savings and digital healthcare platform

offering_description.value: Operates a consumer digital platform that provides coupons and discounted prices on prescription drugs at pharmacies, plus subscription savings programs, telehealth and pharma manufacturer marketing solutions. Serves consumers, pharmacies' customers and pharmaceutical manufacturers through its website, mobile app and integrations.

primary_products.value: prescription discount coupons and savings cards; mobile and web app; subscription savings program

primary_services.value: prescription price comparison and discount access; pharma manufacturer advertising and access solutions; telehealth consultations; pharmacy benefit manager fee-based claims processing

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers and patients, including uninsured and underinsured, filling prescriptions; B2B: pharmaceutical manufacturers buying marketing, pharmacy benefit managers, pharmacies

end_markets.value: retail pharmacy; prescription drugs; pharmaceutical marketing; telehealth

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: fees from pharmacy benefit managers for prescription fills using discount coupons; advertising: pharmaceutical manufacturer solutions such as ads and savings programs; subscription: monthly or annual savings program memberships; service fees: telehealth visits and other consumer health offerings
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; advertising; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: digital marketplace connecting consumers, pharmacies, PBMs and drug manufacturers; financial intermediary: takes price data from PBMs and pharmacies, sells savings to consumers

geography_served.value: US national: Consumers and pharmacies across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: prescription discounts, subscriptions, pharma manufacturer solutions and telehealth

distribution_channels.value: online: GoodRx website and mobile app; partners / resellers: integrations with pharmacies, healthcare providers and partner sites; direct sales: sales team selling to pharmaceutical manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: health data privacy (HIPAA, FTC), telehealth rules, pharmacy and advertising regulation
